header.name: Black Clover: Grimoire Awakening §7(Behavior)
header.description: v1.1.0 - the Untamed Kingdom: named regions with their own danger and traits, landmarks in every region (Mage Spires, Wyvern Roosts, Catacombs, ruined hamlets...), random loot with rarities and rolled relics, Champion and Infernal elites, omens and wanderers; plus a living world, 40 grimoires, 34 Abyss Fruits, nine armour sets and companions. Unofficial fan addon.
